strategy.title: Your Brain Can Stretch a Second Without Changing the Clock
strategy.hook: Fear, novelty, and attention can make equal moments feel radically different in memory.

story_structure.opening: Open with time beside one familiar object the audience instantly recognizes.
story_structure.escalation: Move through three scale jumps, keeping the original object visible as an anchor.
story_structure.takeaway: End with one ratio that makes the scale of time easy to remember and share.

strategy.audience: Curious learners who save and share clear visual explanations.
strategy.visual_direction: Three-stage scale ladder for time; familiar object in foreground, repeated size anchor, dramatic zoom-out, clear depth and measurable contrast
